card.title: Postgres
card.description: One isolated Postgres instance per resource

cli.doc:
usage: flynn pg
       flynn pg:list
       flynn pg:help
       flynn pg:info
       flynn pg:create <database>
       flynn pg:follow [--runtime <name>]
       flynn pg:wait <resource>
       flynn pg:promote <follower>
       flynn pg:unfollow <follower>
       flynn pg:upgrade
       flynn pg:dump [-q] [-f <file>]
       flynn pg:restore [-q] [-f <file>]
       flynn pg:psql [--] [<argument>...]
       flynn pg list
       flynn pg help
       flynn pg info
       flynn pg create <database>
       flynn pg follow [--runtime <name>]
       flynn pg wait <resource>
       flynn pg promote <follower>
       flynn pg unfollow <follower>
       flynn pg upgrade
       flynn pg dump [-q] [-f <file>]
       flynn pg restore [-q] [-f <file>]
       flynn pg psql [--] [<argument>...]

Each resource is its own Postgres instance (one app, one volume, one node).
The colon form (flynn pg:psql) is canonical. The space form (flynn pg psql)
is a fallback. flynn pg:create adds a logical database on that server
(CREATE DATABASE), not a new Flynn resource. Followers are separate resources
and always use streaming replication on the same engine version. There is no
in-place resize or upgrade: pg:upgrade uses logical replication, promotes a
new primary, then recreates each follower against that primary.

With one attached database, pg:psql does not need a name. With a primary and a
follower, pass the instance (postgresql-<word>-<5 digits>). Works on apps that have a
resource but no git release. flynn pg:follow <primary> follows that primary.
flynn pg:psql opens this instance; flynn-host pg:psql is the controller database.
flynn pg:dump and flynn pg:restore dump this tenant instance, not the platform
appliance (flynn-host pg:dump / flynn-host pg:restore).

Options:
	-f, --file=<file>  dump file (stdout/stdin if omitted)
	-q, --quiet        don't print progress
	--runtime=<name>   database runtime for a new follower (default: same as primary)

Commands:
	list      Same as flynn pg with no subcommand
	help      Same as flynn pg --help
	info      Show leader, followers, lag, and attached apps
	create    Create a logical database on this instance
	follow    Create a streaming read-only follower
	wait      Block until follower lag is zero
	promote   Make a follower writable and rewrite the primary URL
	unfollow  Stop replication and leave a standalone writable copy
	upgrade   Follow, wait, promote, then recreate followers
	dump      Dump this instance in custom format
	restore   Restore a dump taken with pg dump
	psql      Open psql against this instance

Examples:

    $ flynn resource:add postgres

    $ flynn pg:create shop_analytics

    $ flynn pg:info

    $ flynn pg:follow <resource> --runtime perf-l

    $ flynn pg:wait <follower>

    $ flynn pg:promote <follower>

    $ flynn pg:unfollow <follower>

    $ flynn pg:upgrade

    $ flynn pg:psql

    $ flynn pg:dump -f postgres.dump

    $ flynn pg:restore -f postgres.dump
cli.resource_missing: No postgres database found. Provision one with `flynn resource:add postgres`
